meta.provenance: CL empirical inventory (t/3447#1) over 916 POV nodes + 33744 edges; CL+TL co-signed (t/3447#3/#4); SO-approved (e/151#2, t/3447#5).
meta.motivation: One declarative source-of-truth for the taxonomy schema, replacing the implicit spread across Zod validators, TS types, PS validators, prompts, and JSON conventions. Existence justified by 4 defects the drafting inventory surfaced that scattering had hidden: t/3448 (rhetorical_strategy vocab drift), t/3449 (steelman_vulnerability type-drift), t/3450 (cross-field contamination), t/3451 (transient residue). That is the answer to the dual-maintenance objection.
meta.scope_note: Covers SHAPE, not content: value sets, types, edge vocab, ID grammar. Per-node data, embeddings metadata, and policy_actions internals are out of scope.
meta.snapshot_note: Fields named cov_at_snapshot (and corpus_snapshot) are INFORMATIONAL only and are NEVER gate inputs. The drift gate compares value sets and types, not coverage.
meta.net_not_gate: A green drift gate means NO DIVERGENCE between this record and its consumers. It does NOT mean the schema is correct — correctness is a human ontology judgment (CL+TL).
meta.record_first: A legitimate new value/type/edge is added to THIS record FIRST (CL+TL co-sign), then to consumers. The gate's failure message repeats this.

change_control.normative_edit_rule: Edits to normative fields require CL+TL co-sign, and re-trigger the t/3361 Second Opinion when they meet its schema/data-model bar (normative removal/retype, or new blocking-gate coupling).
change_control.semver: major = normative removal or retype; minor = additive normative (new enum value, new field, new edge type); patch = non-normative (notes, snapshot, pointers).

sidegrammars.note: cc-node + situation id grammar = v1.1 follow-up section (TL scope ruling)

epistemic_type.notes: Epistemic modality of the claim (AIF I-node quality). empirical_claim/predictive=assertoric+falsifiable; normative_prescription=deontic; strategic_recommendation=practical/means-end; interpretive_lens=framing; definitional=analytic; causal_mechanism=causal.

node_scope.notes: Argumentative granularity. claim=atomic I-node; scheme=AIF argumentation-scheme (S-node/RA pattern); bridging=cross-POV connector; others=abstraction breadth.

falsifiability.notes: Popperian testability qualifier; epistemic quality of the I-node.

rhetorical_strategy.notes: Rhetorical/pragmatic persuasion move (presentation layer, not propositional content). Canonical 16-value set (t/3448, CL+TL co-signed): drift variants merged (evidence_based→appeal_to_evidence, precautionary→precautionary_framing, pragmatic*→pragmatic_framing, cost_benefit→cost_benefit_analysis, fear_appeal→appeal_to_fear, system_critique→systemic_critique, technical_framing→credibility_framing); cross-field contaminants dropped (aspirational/defiant=emotional_register, definitional=epistemic_type). skp-beliefs-251 intentionally uncovered (t/3448).

emotional_register.notes: Affective tone (pathos); presentational quality. t/3450 removes moral_imperative leakage (a rhetorical_strategy value contaminating this field).

audience.notes: Intended addressee(s); AIF dialogical context (target participants).

intellectual_lineage.notes: Genealogy/provenance of the idea (open set, ~63 distinct). Descriptive, not argumentative.

assumes.notes: Presuppositions. RELATIONAL content (semantically the ASSUMES edge / AIF RA-presupposition) stored node-locally; flagged for the intrinsic-vs-relational routing call, not mechanized.

steelman_vulnerability.notes: Strongest counterargument (dialectical). RELATIONAL (semantically CONTRADICTS/WEAKENS / AIF CA) stored as node text. Canonical type = string; t/3449 normalizes the 27 dict-shaped nodes.

aphorism.notes: Camp-voice compressed slogan. Presentational-ONLY (t/1550: never scoring/embedding input).

possible_fallacies.notes: Fallacy tags on the node's reasoning; dialectical quality (AIF CA-type flags).

debate_tested.notes: Process/provenance metadata (test record), not ontological content.

policy_actions.notes: Refs to pol-* ids. RELATIONAL (POV→policy) stored node-locally; flagged for the routing call.

attribution_text.notes: Render of description framing ('A {BDI} within {camp} discourse that…'). DERIVED-DUPLICATION — derived-or-retire; not an independent source.

synthetic_phrases.resolution: REMOVED from corpus t/3433 Phase 3 (commit 45958418; 83 carriers / 660 phrases; archived). Sidecar corpus_{acc,saf,skp}.json is the single canonical store.
synthetic_phrases.notes: Retired node field (was 3rd-person paraphrases for matching/embedding/UI). Tombstone retained so re-add is a visible diff; sidecar remains canonical.

debate_grounding.resolution: LANDED t/3366 (commit abe999fe; 916/916 POV nodes; TL-verified). Canonical debate-grounding home.
debate_grounding.notes: 1st-person own-voice grounding for the debate block; replaced synthetic_phrases' debate role. Sidecar = matching/retrieval/UI.

_phrase_regen_pending.notes: Legal-but-ephemeral processing flag. t/3451 cleans the 27 residual instances; gate treats status:transient as non-drift.

edges.note: 0 non-canonical in live edges[] at snapshot. deprecated_types present so any sprawl re-entry (the ~70 dead llm_proposed class) is a diff, not a silent addition.
